Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misstated the release information for "The Beginning or the End," changing the correctly retrieved 1947 IMDb date (Feb 19, 1947) to an incorrect 1957 date (“June 28, 1957”). This contradicted earlier evidence and led to the wrong conclusion that "Hold Back the Night" (1956) was released first, whereas "The Beginning or the End" (1947) actually predates it.
